column1: For articles in languages other than English
column2: DHQ provides an English-language abstract to support searching and discovery
column3: and to enable those not fluent in the article's original language to get a basic understanding of its contents. In many cases
column4: machine translation may be helpful for those seeking more detailed access. While DHQ does not typically have the resources to translate articles in full
column5: we welcome contributions of effort from readers. If you are interested in translating any article into another language
column6: please contact us at editors@digitalhumanities.org and we will be happy to work with you.
